proposed_from: batch A; refined on blind batch B; confirmed on blind batch C (0 new categories)
rule: One folder per case, chosen by the action needed. Apply the precedence order top-down; the first folder whose definition fits wins. Urgency is a flag, not a folder.

folders.name: Não-cliente
folders.definition: Not a support request: phishing and spam, marketing and SEO pitches, platform notices and surveys, job applications, company administration (trademarks, suppliers).
folders.action: No customer reply. Spam deleted after weekly review; admin/HR forwarded to the right person.

folders.name: Cancelamentos e Reembolsos
folders.definition: The event was cancelled, postponed, moved or changed (time, room, line-up), or may be; or the customer cannot attend and wants to cancel. Includes refund requests and refund-status chasers for these reasons, and complaints about how an event was run that demand a refund.
folders.excludes: Payment-error refunds: charged twice, charged with no order, bought more than intended (F3); paid but no ticket (F2).
folders.action: Check event status and refund policy; process or report refund status.

folders.name: Bilhetes não recebidos
folders.definition: Purchase completed/paid but the ticket did not arrive, cannot be opened, was sent to a wrong e-mail, or is needed in another format (PDF); resend requests. Also: a wrong ticket was issued (wrong event, zone or date). Tie-break F2 vs F3: if the customer saw an error or pending status at checkout, or was charged twice/too much -> F3; if checkout completed normally and there is no usable ticket -> F2.
folders.action: Look up the order and resend.

folders.name: Compra e Pagamento
folders.definition: Problems buying or paying: checkout/site errors, payment pending or failed, payment method or country not accepted, duplicate charge, order-status confirmation, invoices/fatura/NIF. Also: duplicate or mistaken purchases and charges without an order, including the refund of those. Tie-break F2 vs F3: if the customer saw an error or pending status at checkout, or was charged twice/too much -> F3; if checkout completed normally and there is no usable ticket -> F2.
folders.action: Check order/payment; fix or refund duplicate; issue invoice.

folders.name: Alterações de Reserva
folders.definition: Change an existing booking: date/session, seats, zone, ticket holder name.

folders.name: Informações do Evento
folders.definition: Questions about an event that is going ahead: availability, prices and promotions, VIP contents, age limits, venue/address, schedule, weather, accessibility.

folders.name: A Rever
folders.definition: Read by hand. Empty, unintelligible, or a formal notice whose content is not visible; anything that fits none of the above. Also: people who bought from another company (misdirected); merchandise and shop orders from artist shops (e.g. Yanns, Loja Oficial Calema): order status, delivery date, address or size changes, missing confirmation; organisers, venues, promoters and B2B contacts writing about running events: sales windows, ticket control, sales reports, payouts, partnerships (if a partner forwards or relays ONE customer's problem, classify by that customer's issue instead).
folders.action: Read by hand; shop orders checked with the shop/fulfilment, partners followed up by Tickett.

flags.definition: Legal action or consumer-body involvement (Test Achats, Livro de Reclamações, registered e-letters such as AR24), chargeback or media threats, event today/tomorrow, or 3+ unanswered follow-ups. Also: a formal complaint already filed (Livro de Reclamações, Portal da Queixa).
